Each generation is more "opinionated" than the last, with the Harness building in planning, memory, file systems, and compression capabilities. yu0e8e:110: Moura's core concept: the "entanglement" metaphor borrowed from physics — when two particles are entangled, the state of one is immediately reflected in the state of the other.
